turns.input: *He punches Bartolomhew directly in the face.*
turns.draft:
Your fist catches Bartolomhew square on the jaw before anyone can react. His head snaps sideways, the warm smile vanishing mid-word. He staggers back a step, catches himself against a wooden post, and blinks — a thin thread of blood welling from the corner of his mouth where his lip has split. The big man looks more startled than frightened, one hand going up to feel his jaw as if confirming what just happened.

Korvin lets out a short bark of laughter from his crate, though his small eyes are sharp and watchful. Mistress Elara steps back half a pace with a soft gasp, her fan snapping shut. The two handlers near Bartolomhew's stock start forward, hands going to their belts. Bartolomhew spits blood onto the dirt, straightens, and looks at you with that same calm, measuring courtesy — as though you were a difficult animal at auction rather than a man who just struck him.

"Well," he says mildly, dabbing his lip with a handkerchief he produces from somewhere in his elegant clothing. "That was unkind. I do hope you'll explain yourself before my associates feel obliged to be unkind in return."
